async def act(page):
    # Click the 'Epoch & Drift Benchmark' link to navigate to the homepage
    await page.get_by_role('link', name='Epoch & Drift Benchmark').click()
    
    # Wait for the page to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    
    # Find all articles on the page
    articles = page.get_by_role('article')
    count = await articles.count()
    
    if count < 3:
        # If not enough articles, return an error message
        return f"Not enough articles found. Only {count} article(s) available."
    
    # Get the third-to-last article (index count-3)
    third_last_article = articles.nth(count - 3)
    
    # Extract title: look for a heading within the article
    title_element = third_last_article.get_by_role('heading').first
    title = await title_element.text_content() if await title_element.count() > 0 else "No title found"
    
    # Extract category: look for a link or text that might indicate category
    # Use filter to find elements with 'category' in their name or text
    category_element = third_last_article.get_by_role('link').filter(has_text='category')
    if await category_element.count() == 0:
        # If no link, try to find in paragraph or generic text
        category_element = third_last_article.get_by_role('paragraph').filter(has_text='category')
    if await category_element.count() == 0:
        # If still not found, try any element with text containing 'category'
        category_element = third_last_article.get_by_text('category')
    category = await category_element.text_content() if await category_element.count() > 0 else "No category found"
    
    # Return the result as a string
    result = f"Title: {title}, Category: {category}"
    return result
